supportClaimEffect: none; native compatibility gate remains open
scope: A locally generated R13 source was projected to an R2000 DXF with a scratch-only bypass of the production legacy layout refusal. A macOS LibreCAD window opened it and saved a separate copy at the same DXF version.
observations: The native application opened and displayed the drawing and saved a copied drawing as AC1015 without an omission warning.

Independent readback found the original line geometry and both layout names, with no reported audit errors or fixes. The paper layout no longer has its ACAD_XDICTIONARY link; its dictionary and child XRECORD remain physically present but are no longer linked by that layout. Both layout ACAD_REACTORS groups are absent in the saved file.

A current-head libdxfrw import probe independently retained the original paper layout xdictionary handle 0x33 and both layouts reactor groups. The first window was selected by application name while two LibreCAD processes were running, so its exact process and codec are not established; the loss cannot be attributed to a particular binary or codec.
limits: This diagnostic source uses a scratch-only guard bypass; it does not establish production DWG export or a general support claim.

A path-selected consumer using the current codec is tested separately in p8d-legacy-layout-native-current-codec-2026-11-28.json; the unidentified earlier result remains a compatibility warning, not evidence of a defect in the current candidate.
Native dictionary cloning, other layout graphs, releases and platforms remain unqualified. No drawing fixture was committed.
